text:
Sam R: Quick one 1 help understanding how orthodontia claims coordinate with my spouse's plan. I submitted to Redwoods carrier and got a partial payment but provider says secondary should cover more.
Benefits Team: Hi Sam  can you share the EOB and the treatment dates? Orthodontia often has separate lifetime maximums and different coordination rules.
Sam R: Uploaded EOB here: https://redwood-cloud/internal-uploads/claims/1831200456-eob-orthodontics.pdf Treatment started 02/01/2026. The carrier paid $1,200 and said spouses plan is primary? That seems backwards.
benefits-bot: Automated note: For coordination of benefits (COB), the plan primary is generally the one covering the subscriber of the patient. If dependent coverage spans two employers, the birthday rule or active employment status may apply. See internal COB guide: https://docs.redwood.com/benefits/cob.
COB Admin: Sam  who is listed as primary on the provider claim (subscriber name)? Also is your spouses coverage listed as "employee" or "dependent" on their employer portal?
Sam R: On the claim the subscriber is listed as Sam R (me). My spouse, Alex, is listed as "other insured" and Alexs employer shows active coverage (employee). Alex is the one who can log into their carrier portal and confirm.
Priya S: Two common scenarios: 1) If the patient (child) is covered as a dependent under Alexs employee plan and Alexs plan is active and meant to be primary, carrier may still process against Sams plan first if paperwork or COB indicator was missing. 2) Orthodontia sometimes requires filing predetermination to each carrier with the same attachments. We can help file a secondary claim for the unpaid portion.
Sam R: The provider sent a predetermination to my plan only. They said they were told by Alexs HR that Alexs plan is secondary. Messy.
COB Admin: OK we can do a COB submission. Please DM the following: childs DOB, claim number from EOB (CLM-5742), provider tax ID, and a copy of Alexs insurance card (front/back). We need both EOB and the primary paid amount to submit secondary.
Sam R: DM sent with Alexs insurance card and CLM-5742.
Benefits Team: Received. We'll prepare a secondary claim packet and submit to Alexs carrier with a cover letter referencing the primary EOB. Note: secondary may apply plan maximums differently (lifetime ortho). Could be carrier offsets so final patient responsibility may still be similar.
Spouse Billing: Filing note from provider: they billed following the payment remittance and applied $200 patient balance; they expect secondary to adjudicate the remaining $1000 of the submitted $2,200 predetermination.
Benefits Team: Timeline: we will submit the COB within 2 business days. Carrier response for secondary adjudication typically 14-30 days for orthodontia predeterminations. If provider needs a copy of the COB request, we can send a practitioner cover email.
Sam R: If the secondary denies for coordination reasons, do we have appeal options?
Priya S: Yes. Common appeal reasons are incorrect subscriber order or missing COB information. If secondary denies, we can request reconsideration and supply proof of primary payment and enrolment documents from Alexs employer. If necessary benefits will assist in escalation to carrier account rep.
benefits-bot: Helpful checklist for COB submission:
``
- Primary EOB (CLM-5742)
- Predetermination estimate from provider
- Provider tax ID and NPI
- Dependents birth certificate if requested
- Copy of secondary insurance card
```
Sam R: Thanks 1 appreciate the checklist. One more  provider quoted a lifetime ortho max of $1,500 on my plan, but predetermination total is $2,200. Will I be on the hook for the $700 difference if secondary covers nothing?
Benefits Team: Potentially yes. If your plan has a $1,500 lifetime orthodontia maximum and the total course is $2,200, the standard flow is: primary pays per its allowed amounts up to its maximums; secondary may pay the remainder up to its limits. If combined payments still leave a shortfall, that is patient responsibility. We will confirm both carriers allowed amounts and provide an estimate once secondary adjudicates.
Sam R: Understood. Thanks for handling the COB submission.
COB Admin: Submitted to Alexs carrier (case COB-9901). We attached primary EOB and predetermination. Will update thread when we hear back.
Sam R: Thanks everyone  will wait to hear. :thumbsup:
